t: When creating a Claude Managed Agents session, you can now override the agent’s configuration for that session.
s: Pass agent with type: "agent_with_overrides" to replace the model, system prompt, tools, MCP servers, or skills for a single session. The agent itself is unchanged.

t: Claude Managed Agents vaults now support an injection_location setting on environment variable credentials (the Environment variable tab).
s: It controls whether the credential’s value is substituted, at egress, into the agent’s outbound request headers, the request body, or both.

t: Webhooks for Claude Managed Agents now cover the agent, deployment, and deployment run lifecycle.
s: You can react to a newly published agent version, a paused deployment, or a failed scheduled run without polling.

t: Claude Managed Agents session event streams now support event deltas.
s: Opt in with the event_deltas[] query parameter on GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/stream. The event_start and event_delta events preview an agent message’s text as it’s generated, before the complete agent.message…

t: Claude Sonnet 5 launch
s: We launched Claude Sonnet 5, our most agentic Sonnet model yet, with substantial improvements over Sonnet 4.6 in reasoning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work.

t: We’ve launched Claude Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5), the next generation of our Sonnet model family, at introductory pricing of $2 / $10 USD per MTok (made the…
s: We’ve launched Claude Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5), the next generation of our Sonnet model family, at introductory pricing of $2 / $10 USD per MTok (made the standard price on August 10, 2026). Claude Sonnet 5 supports a…

t: Listing sessions for Claude Managed Agents now supports backward pagination.
s: GET /v1/sessions returns a prev_page cursor alongside next_page; pass it as the page parameter to return to the previous page.

t: We’ve removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.6.
s: Requests to claude-opus-4-6 with speed: "fast" no longer run at fast speed or premium pricing: they run at standard speed, are billed at standard rates, and do not return an error. The response’s usage.speed field…

t: We’ve raised rate limits across the Claude API.
s: Claude Sonnet and Claude Haiku rate limits now match Claude Opus at every usage tier, and usage tiers have been consolidated into three: Start, Build, and Scale. Most organizations move to a higher tier, no organization…

t: We’ve deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7, with removal on July 24, 2026.
s: After removal, requests to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" will return an error. Migrate to fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8.

t: Enable Trusted Devices for Remote Control
s: Admins for Team and Enterprise plans can now require members to verify their device before viewing or steering local Claude Code sessions remotely.

t: Delegate work to Claude in Slack with Claude Tag
s: Team and Enterprise plans can now tag Claude directly in Slack conversations and delegate tasks to it while they focus on other work.

t: MCP tunnels

s: The Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP, and C# SDKs now include support for code_execution_20260120, the code execution tool version that adds REPL state persistence and is the minimum version for programmatic tool…

t: We’ve retired the Claude Sonnet 4 model (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) and the Claude Opus 4 model (claude-opus-4-20250514).
s: All requests to these models on the Claude API will now return an error. We recommend upgrading to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 respectively. Researchers can request ongoing access through the External…

t: Access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 suspended
s: We've suspended access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5. We aim to return access as quickly as we can.

t: Edit Claude’s drafts in place
s: When Claude writes a draft in chat or Claude Cowork (a report, a plan, a brief), it opens right beside your chat. Highlight the part you want changed, type the change, and Claude makes the edit right where you marked…

t: The code execution tool now supports code_execution_20260521, which discloses the 90-second per-cell execution time limit in the tool description so Claude can…
s: The code execution tool now supports code_execution_20260521, which discloses the 90-second per-cell execution time limit in the tool description so Claude can budget long-running cells. No beta header is required.

s: The web search tool and web fetch tool now support web_search_20260318 and web_fetch_20260318, adding a response_inclusion parameter to drop consumed result blocks from the API response for agentic workflows. No beta…

t: The GET /v1/environments/{id}/work endpoint, which lists pending work for a self-hosted sandbox, is now available on Claude Platform on AWS.
Claude Fable 5 launch
s: We launched Claude Fable 5, a Mythos-class model that we’ve made safe for general use.

t: Enterprise plans can manage admin permissions with custom roles
s: We extended the existing custom roles framework by adding admin permissions. Admin permissions give members access to specific administrative areas, like billing or privacy, without the need to make them Owners.
